<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)]]
**A United States [[airstrike]] in Afghanistan early Saturday kills 10 children and 3 adults. The family was displaced because of the conflict according to early findings by the [[United Nations Assistance Mission in Afghanistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-casualties/ten-children-killed-by-u-s-air-strike-in-afghanistan-u-n-idUSKCN1R60V0 (Reuters)]

;Arts and culture
*The 2019 [[Global Teacher Prize]] and its $1 million  (£760,000) purse is awarded to Brother Peter Tabichi, a [[Franciscans|Franciscan]] science teacher from rural [[Kenya]]. Tabichi gives away 80 percent of his salary to support poorer pupils at the Keriko Mixed Day Secondary School in Pwani Village, [[Nakuru]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-47658803 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Stoneman Douglas High School shooting|Stoneman Douglas High School massacre aftermath]]
**More than 60 school, county, city, child services and law enforcement officials, as well as mental health specialists, teachers and parents, hold an emergency meeting after the suicide of a second Stoneman Douglas survivor. Florida's emergency chief is requesting the state Legislature provide more mental health resources for the community. [[Coral Springs, Florida]], police reported that, Saturday night, a current sophomore killed himself. Last week, Sydney Aiello, a 19-year-old graduate who had recently been diagnosed with post-traumatic stress disorder, took her own life. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2019/mar/24/parkland-student-second-death (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.miamiherald.com/news/local/community/broward/article228350134.html (''Miami Herald'')]

;International relations
*[[Russia–Venezuela relations]]
**Two [[Russia]]n military planes, an [[Ilyushin Il-62]] and an [[Antonov An-124 Ruslan|Antonov An-124]] land at [[Simón Bolívar International Airport (Venezuela)|Simón Bolívar International Airport]] near [[Caracas]], [[Venezuela]], carrying senior Defence Ministry official {{ill|Vasily Tonkoshkurov|ru|Тонкошкуров, Василий Петрович}}, a large amount of equipment and about 100 troops. Russia, which three months earlier held joint military exercises on Venezuelan soil, condemned other countries for backing Venezuelan opposition leader [[Juan Guaidó]] against embattled [[President of Venezuela|President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics/russian-air-force-planes-land-in-venezuela-carrying-troops-reports-idUSKCN1R50NB (Reuters)]  [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-46989279 (BBC)] 

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Thai general election]]
**Voters in [[Thailand]] head to the polls to elect all 500 members of the [[House of Representatives (Thailand)|House of Representatives]]. This is the first parliamentary election held in the country since the invalidation of the [[2014 Thai general election]] and the ensuing [[2014 Thai coup d'état]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-thailand-election/thai-voters-go-to-polls-as-coup-leader-democratic-front-face-off-idUSKCN1R5027 (Reuters)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/thailands-military-junta-allows-first-elections-in-8-years-but-the-rules-appear-to-tip-in-its-favor/2019/03/23/b29f36fa-4bd2-11e9-8cfc-2c5d0999c21e_story.html?noredirect=on&utm_term=.6713bae9e993 (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[2019 Comorian presidential election]]
**Voters in the [[Comoros]] head to the polls to elect a new [[President of the Comoros|President]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-47685991 (BBC)]
*[[Special Counsel investigation (2017–2019)]]
**Special Counsel [[Robert Mueller]]'s report on [[Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections]] does not find that any US officials or [[Donald Trump 2016 presidential campaign|Trump campaign]] members knowingly conspired with the government of [[Russia]]. Mueller drew no conclusions about whether Trump [[Obstruction of justice|illegally obstructed justice]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-russia-barr/mueller-does-not-find-trump-campaign-knowingly-conspired-with-russia-idUSKCN1R50RG (Reuters)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/03/24/us/politics/mueller-report-summary.html (''The New York Times'')]
**Attorney General William Barr releases the "principal conclusions" of Mueller's investigation in a four-page public letter to the Congress's [[Judiciary Committee]] leadership. [https://www.foxnews.com/politics/barr-releases-letter-summarizing-muellers-key-findings-after-long-running-russia-probe (Fox News)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2019/03/24/takeaways-mueller-reports-principal-conclusions/?utm_term=.cabfa868c97a (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/context/read-attorney-general-barr-s-principal-conclusions-of-the-mueller-report/?noteId=9048a12b-2332-4645-a1be-d645db216eb5&questionId=218b8095-c5e3-4eab-9135-4170f5b3e87f&utm_term=.1cc3924e144f (William Barr letter to congress via ''The Washington Post'')]
*Thousands of teachers gather in the capital of [[Rabat]], [[Morocco]] to protests working conditions and wages. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-47684913 (BBC)] [https://www.france24.com/en/20190324-thousands-moroccan-teachers-protest-over-pay-rabat-education (France 24)]
